slides.say: This GitHub project has been around since 2026, and it lets you let your AI agent search the whole internet.

slides.headline: Reads Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, more
slides.body: This tool lets your AI agent search and read Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu without API fees.
slides.say: It gives your AI agent eyes to see the whole internet — Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu — all without API fees.

slides.headline: 108,614 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in Python · Since February 2026
slides.say: It has over 100 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence.

slides.headline: Read-only, uses your browser
slides.body: It only reads — never posts or logs in for you — and runs in a dedicated browser on your computer.
